rule: Base stage for every D1-3 beat on a kitchen / kitchen_table4 set that has no template-shot stage. Existing canonical props only, catalog ids from app/scenes/day10-kitchen/scene.json, canonical scale (pixelScale 1). Positions = positive-control positions; propPlacement pins them even if the catalog moves.

notes.laptop: Baked into prop.desk (spec d2_a3: no separate handprop laptop, E-PROP-DUP). The catalog 'laptop' prop is NOT staged; propStates.laptop=open keeps state consistent.
notes.plant_slot: plant at (177,118) is the pot-1 slot. When a beat's world carries pot_desk_sprout/young/full, the existing sitcom-stage rule omits 'plant' and draws pot 1 at the same slot (spec d1_b_feuille).
notes.table4: table/chairs at y131 as in the control; seated-actor table4 rendering is unchanged.
notes.deskSlots: Desk-top slots relative to the prop.desk.* sprite top-left (anchorPoint 16,19 at desk placement 166,131), from the kitchen manifest: cat (15,6) -> (165,118), plant (27,7) -> (177,119).
notes.laptop_off: beatOverrides set propStates.laptop=off per beat; the player masks the baked laptop_glow (light/soir.json x165 y114 r12) and desk_bare (if staged) replaces prop.desk.
notes.desk_bare: Pixel art prop.desk_bare.{day,evening,night} (atlas days_props3, frame 0,0,32,20, anchor feet 16,19, slot kitchen_desk 166,131, deskSlots cat 15,6 / plant 27,7). Drawn when laptopIsOff(propStates); the same predicate puts laptop_glow in stage.lightMasks so the player masks it.
